normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the deeded beach access or take the complimentary tram- Access to Seacrest's 12,000-square-foot community pool and multiple community parks (including one directly across the street)- 3 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: Experience the exceptional charm of Seacrest Beach at Shrimply The Best! This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom, 3-level abode comfortably accommodates 8 guests. Indulge in days of in-the-water fun at the community’s 12,000-square-foot pool, picnicking in the multiple parks, or relaxing on the front porch. With beach access only a 10-minute walk away, plus shops and restaurants in the nearby town square, guests can effortlessly enjoy a laid-back getaway full of sandcastles, suntans, and ice cream. Palm trees, a spacious veranda with 2 pink Adirondack chairs, and a matching porch swing welcome guests to this charming home. Warm wood floors stretch throughout the connected first-level living, dining, and kitchen areas, while natural light filtering through the glass doors and windows brighten the space. A modern sofa and plush armchair offer seating around the TV and coffee table. The white-hued kitchen has high-end appliances and a breakfast bar for 3, ideal for entertaining while cooking delicious bites to share at the 4-person table. For convenience, there’s a laundry room to the side and an outdoor shower out the back door.Take the stairs to the beautiful primary bedroom on the second level, featuring a king bed, private bathroom, and furnished balcony with an overhead fan—perfect for guests to savor the sunset. Additionally, there is a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a private bathroom.The third level hosts a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds and access to a crow’s nest balcony with 2 chairs.Enjoy a carefree Seacrest Beach vacation minutes from beach access at Shrimply The Best. There’s parking for up to 2 vehicles on a first-come, first-serve basis, or take advantage of the 3 complimentary adult bikes and seasonal tram service. For beach access, follow Beach Bike Way, turn left onto Seacrest Beach Boulevard West, then cross East County Highway 30A, and continue onto South Seacrest Beach Boulevard to the beach access. Book this delightful home for a Scenic 30A getaway today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):SECOND FLOOR:-Primar Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Bunk Room/Crow's Nest: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds with access to the Martini Deck*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

DETAILS: Experience the exceptional charm of Seacrest Beach at Shrimply The Best! This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom, 3-level abode comfortably accommodates 8 guests. Indulge in days of in-the-water fun at the community’s 12,000-square-foot pool, picnicking in the multiple parks, or relaxing on the front porch. With beach access only a 10-minute walk away, plus shops and restaurants in the nearby town square, guests can effortlessly enjoy a laid-back getaway full of sandcastles, suntans, and ice cream. Palm trees, a spacious veranda with 2 pink Adirondack chairs, and a matching porch swing welcome guests to this charming home. Warm wood floors stretch throughout the connected first-level living, dining, and kitchen areas, while natural light filtering through the glass doors and windows brighten the space. A modern sofa and plush armchair offer seating around the TV and coffee table. The white-hued kitchen has high-end appliances and a breakfast bar for 3, ideal for entertaining while cooking delicious bites to share at the 4-person table. For convenience, there’s a laundry room to the side and an outdoor shower out the back door. Take the stairs to the beautiful primary bedroom on the second level, featuring a king bed, private bathroom, and furnished balcony with an overhead fan—perfect for guests to savor the sunset. Additionally, there is a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a private bathroom. The third level hosts a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds and access to a crow’s nest balcony with 2 chairs. Enjoy a carefree Seacrest Beach vacation minutes from beach access at Shrimply The Best. There’s parking for up to 2 vehicles on a first-come, first-serve basis, or take advantage of the 3 complimentary adult bikes and seasonal tram service. For beach access, follow Beach Bike Way, turn left onto Seacrest Beach Boulevard West, then cross East County Highway 30A, and continue onto South Seacrest Beach Boulevard to the beach access. Book this delightful home for a Scenic 30A getaway today!
